integrity.infinite_proof: The all-n assertions follow from parity-chain factorization, Fibonacci parity, and two periodic signed-recursion witnesses, not extrapolation from computation.

limitations: Applies to the full family of total dominating vertex sets of labelled paths of order n>=2; not general graphs. Does not give full multiplicity spectra or endpoint projection norms. Priority comparison is bounded; full text of a plausible trivariate total-domination-polynomial paper was unavailable.
title: Fourier recovery and the sharp fourfold spectral gap of total domination on paths
